mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.subject_id AS subjectId, q.difficult AS difficulty, tc.content AS questionContent FROM t_question q LEFT JOIN t_text_content tc ON q.info_text_content_id = tc.id WHERE q.id = #{questionId} AND q.deleted = 0

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.subject_id AS subjectId, q.difficult AS difficulty, tc.content AS questionContent FROM t_question q LEFT JOIN t_text_content tc ON q.info_text_content_id = tc.id WHERE q.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND q.id != #{excludeQuestionId} AND q.deleted = 0 LIMIT 300

SELECT eqca.question_id AS questionId, eqca.subject_id AS subjectId, q.difficult AS difficulty, tc.content AS questionContent FROM t_exam_paper_question_customer_answer eqca LEFT JOIN t_question q ON eqca.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN t_text_content tc ON q.info_text_content_id = tc.id WHERE eqca.create_user = #{studentId} AND eqca.do_right = FALSE AND q.deleted = 0 ORDER BY eqca.create_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.subject_id AS subjectId, q.difficult AS difficulty, tc.content AS questionContent FROM t_question q LEFT JOIN t_text_content tc ON q.info_text_content_id = tc.id WHERE q.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND q.deleted = 0 LIMIT 300

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.subject_id AS subjectId, q.difficult AS difficulty, tc.content AS questionContent FROM t_question q LEFT JOIN t_text_content tc ON q.info_text_content_id = tc.id WHERE q.deleted = 0 ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
